set.body:
## Scope
Define the versioned activity envelope and evidence contracts before storage or monitoring work. Repair `next_action` so it projects independent execution, artifact, validation, dependency, freshness, and monitor-health axes rather than inferring all-clear from scheduler completion alone.

Define source precedence, identity, timestamps, provenance, retention, and operator-facing attention categories. Suggested actions remain advisory and must not authorize side effects.

## Acceptance criteria
- The schema identifies event version/id/sequence, subject and attempt identity, provenance/evidence reference, recorded/observed/occurred timestamps, freshness, actor/operation id, and causation/correlation where available.
- Tests cover COMPLETED with missing outputs and NOT_RUN validation; cancelled or failed work; blocked/conflicting dependencies; stale validation; unavailable evidence; and contradictory sources. Each returns attention or uncertainty, never a misleading complete/no-intervention result.
- The same logical evidence produces the same attention decision whether it was obtained by direct refresh, passive recovery, or the observer.
- Attention output separates observed fact, evidence/source, freshness, recommended action, and authorization state.
- The public contract marks the journal as presentation history and remote ledger, scheduler, validation, and campaign records as authorities.
set.title: A0: repair attention projection and freeze activity semantics
